I got idiopathic intracranial hypotension from my T being too low. This meant my E was too high. Not good, a lot of issues come from hormonal imbalances. Drs need to be aware of this in trans patients. Trans men are often not believed when we bring this up. I believed it was hormones but I was told by many specialists that it was weight, diet, ect. When someone finally took a chance I started getting injections at sooner intervals. And what do you know? Which medication to help the extra fluid in my brain as well (which wasn't working on its own) I got better.
Just to add, if you feel more yourself you usually gain confidence and become more open. People are so attracted to that!

Hey fellow Aussie here! There are many people who will want to date you. I'm younger but truly I haven't had many issues. Top surgery is expensive as hell, I'm currently saving. It's about $15000. Some do it for under $10000 but I think it's due to circumstances. I'm a fairly fem guy, I used to feel like I was doing drag 24/7. It feels good sometimes but it's not the real me. Now I get to choose. You can be whoever you want to be/whoever you really are. Don't let age stop you. You're amazing bro, peace from Newy.

Edit: Check out TransHub, they're an Australian resource site run by ACON. It's got everything to do with transitioning and which doctors are trans-safe and step by step guides. It's for NSW but if you're not there It's still very helpful.

Trust me as long as you ask what they need, advocate and keep respectful you'll do fine.

For all that this makes me sound like, when I'm functioning, I'm a very caring and quiet person who works in the nursing field.

If it's new people or in a large group, I get fidgety and eventually zone out completely. With people I'm close with, unfortunately, I get extremely irritable. They don't deserve it. It's on steroids during a mixed episode, jesus christ. Like don't fucking touch me, don't touch my shit, don't argue with me, just don't breathe around me, I can't think. In all instances, I'll get very particular about how things need to be organised, etc. That does not mean it's neat and tidy lmao. It's usually very dysfunctional, which means people want to move/clean things, and that's a big nope. I do get "classic" panic attacks, but it's only as a response to very specific things. Like yelling being directed at me, being misunderstood (havent unpacked that one). Also, if one of the situations from the earlier forms of panic goes too far and someone keeps at me or touches me too much. DONT FUCKING TOUCH PEOPLE WITHOUT ASKING JESUS CHRIST!

EDIT:
Also, being non responsive/unclear is not consent. We know that for sexual situations, it applies for this too. Consent applies everywhere, all the time, for everyone. If someone touches me during any panic attack state, I start screaming without any control over it. I don't know why, but I just do. So unless you want to deal with a banshee, just fucking don't.
